item.title: Stop Foodborne Illness Petitions FDA to Name Brands Tied to Foodborne Illness Outbreaks
item.description: The petition, submitted Feb. 5, asks the FDA to change its interpretation that a company name is confidential commercial information and allow disclosure of the name of a company linked to a foodborne illness outbreak, even if there is no related recall.

item.title: WorkForge Expands Food Safety Training Platform
item.description: The company's training platform expansion is headlined by its new Listeria safety content. The release also includes updated food safety, health & safety, and anhydrous ammonia content.

item.title: SQF Institute Announces Excellence Awards Finalists
item.description: The Excellence in SQF Auditing and Excellence in SQF Practitioner Leadership awards recognize individuals for their outstanding performance and contributions to furthering the mission of the SQF program and promoting food safety.

item.title: IFT Webinar to Examine the Impact of GLP-1s on Product Design and Development
item.description: The webinar, which is titled “Smaller Plates: Bigger Opportunities: Designing Food for Post-GLP-1 Appetites,” will unpack what the GLP-1 revolution means for food and beverage product design and development, analyze the impact it has had on the food system and predict future weight management trends, IFT said.

item.title: AFDO Opens Registration for 2026 Annual Educational Conference
item.description: Registration is now open for the 130th Association of Food and Drug Officials Annual Educational Conference, which is scheduled for June 5-9 at the Hyatt Regency Columbus in Columbus, Ohio.

item.title: Barry Callebaut Opens Global Innovation Center in Singapore
item.description: The company said the GIC is located at Geneo in Singapore Science Park and brings together two centers of excellence (CoEs), including an Artificial Intelligence CoE dedicated to chocolate and cocoa, and a Cacao Coatings compound CoE.

item.title: USDA FSIS Establishes Consumer Safety Inspector Training Leader Position
item.description: The new position was created to strengthen on-the-job training and promote consistent application of policy for inspection program personnel nationwide.

item.title: USDA Opens Sterile Fly Dispersal Facility in Texas
item.description: The facility, created to aid the agency’s fight against New World screwworm, expands USDA’s ability to disperse sterile flies along the border and into the United States, if necessary.

item.title: Oracle Offers New Capabilities in Supply Chain and Manufacturing
item.description: Oracle Fusion Cloud Supply Chain and Manufacturing has newly added features that support mixed-mode manufacturing strategies.

item.title: FAO Releases Report on Fish Fraud
item.description: “Food fraud in the fisheries and aquaculture sector,” was produced by FAO through cooperation between its Fisheries and Aquaculture Division and the Joint FAO/International Atomic Energy Agency Centre of Nuclear Techniques in Food and Agriculture.
